data.name: Ashraf
data.gender_notes: Ashraf is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Elative of the Arabic root ش-ر-ف (sh-r-f), 'to be noble' — 'most noble'. Its root is ش-ر-ف (sh-r-f). A common Muslim given name. Ashraf is a Arabic name meaning “Most noble; most honourable”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ashraf expresses “Most noble; most honourable”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Elative of the Arabic root ش-ر-ف (sh-r-f), 'to be noble' — 'most noble'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ashraf total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
